scope: Real checked Object export for optimization15 only; no timing observations or linked Object execution.

profiled_loop_checks_before.method: AArch64 instruction CFG, reachable dominators and natural backedges; innermost loops contain no strict natural subloop. Static counts are not runtime percentages.
profiled_loop_checks_before.cycle_limit: Static minimum-comparison CFG cycles demonstrate an available path, not input feasibility, dynamic counts or measured speed. Differential execution proves current-input correctness and the subsequent one-probe measurements decide performance.
